chunks: O my father, I fear lest a punishment from Ar-Rahman should befall you, and you should become a friend of the Devil.

key_terms.الرَّحْمٰنِ: The Merciful (one of the names of God)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'lest a punishment from Ar-Rahman befall you' signify in the context of Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In Surah Mary, this verse captures the plea of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) to his father Azar, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and gentle persuasion even when addressing polytheistic parents. It underscores the spiritual danger of *wilayah* (alliance) with Shaytan for those who persist in disbelief despite clear signs, highlighting the transition from familial duty to divine accountability.
